title: Plan the Cheapest Chain, Execute One Legal Step
principle: For a crafting goal, reason about possible recipe chains and choose the chain with the lowest primitive-resource cost. Keep this chosen chain fixed while executing the task, and update the plan only when an observation proves that an assumed resource or intermediate item is unavailable.
when_to_apply: Multi-step crafting tasks with alternative recipes.

title: Recipe-Tree Ledger with Exact Commands
principle: Before acting, track the target recipe tree, owned items, and missing ingredients. When a recipe produces more than the goal needs, craft the provided output quantity and treat extra items as inventory. During execution, maintain a resource ledger and verify that every intermediate quantity satisfies future recipe requirements.
when_to_apply: Whenever multiple crafting paths exist or the target requires more than one crafting step.

title: Avoid Invalid Batch Actions
principle: A TextCraft action must be exactly one command. Valid get commands contain one item type only, such as get 6 quartz; never write get 6 quartz, 6 cobblestone. Valid craft commands must match a listed crafting command exactly, including the output count; never write craft 12 diorite if the listed command is craft 2 diorite using 2 quartz, 2 cobblestone. To make repeated quantities, execute the same valid command over multiple turns.
when_to_apply: Every TextCraft step, especially after a failed action or when planning total resource requirements.
